answer: Run a random audit lottery each epoch. 5 percent of identities are drawn for a check of graded work and payment anchor, and auditors earn a bounty from forfeited deposits. A farm of 1,000 fake identities faces 50 audits per epoch, and each failure burns pending rewards plus a 100 POA deposit. A willow bends and survives, but a farm cannot bend around 50 audits; its balance hits its nadir when losses pass payouts, and a walnut shell of shared templates cracks under a check of distinct work. Failed identities lose their slot for two epochs, so replacements start again from zero.
